Critical severity

critical

Implicit state ownership across feature boundaries

Evidence: Multiple services mutate shared state without a declared owner or recovery path.

Risk: Feature changes can create regressions in unrelated workflows.

Recommendation: Define feature state ownership and isolate data access behind explicit boundaries.

High severity

high

Unhandled data and error states in user-facing flows

Evidence: Loading, empty, retry, and failure states are handled inconsistently across screens.

Risk: Users see broken or ambiguous states during normal API failures.

Recommendation: Introduce typed request states and shared error presentation rules.

Medium severity

medium

Cache semantics are undocumented

Evidence: Several streams cache API responses without expiry, invalidation, or ownership rules.

Risk: Users can see stale data and engineers cannot predict when updates propagate.

Recommendation: Define cache ownership, invalidation triggers, and stale-data UI states.

Sprint roadmap

Sprint 1

  • Implicit state ownership across feature boundaries
  • Unhandled data and error states in user-facing flows

Sprint 2

  • Cache semantics are undocumented
